The "Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater" provides a comprehensive evaluation of 11 clinical quality indicators for [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) care in Denmark, comparing the 2023/24 reporting period against historical data from 2021/22 and 2022/23 [^src1]. Managed under frameworks such as the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]], these metrics are critical for assessing diagnostic workflows, long-term treatment adherence, and patient safety outcomes [^src1].

In the 2023/24 period, only a minority of the indicators successfully met their predefined clinical standards [^src1]. The leaders in target achievement include Indikator 1, which tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed patients starting anticoagulation therapy within 30 days; it reached 91.6%, comfortably meeting the ≥90% standard [^src1]. Indikator 2, measuring echocardiography performance, also crossed its ≥80% threshold with a score of 80.6%, demonstrating a steady upward trend from 76.7% in 2021/22 [^src1]. Furthermore, the clinical outcome indicators for stroke (Indikator 5) and intracranial bleeding (Indikator 6) remained stable and within their safe limits, recording incidences of 0.8 and 0.5 respectively, thus meeting the ≤0.8 and ≤0.6 standards [^src1].

Conversely, several indicators missed their targets, with Indikator 8 standing out as a massive outlier and the clear trailer [^src1]. The standard for providing newly diagnosed patients with a structured educational program within the first year is set at ≥50%, yet the actual fulfillment was only 15.9% [^src1]. Although this represents a significant relative improvement from 8.2% in 2022/23, it remains drastically below the target [^src1]. Indikator 3, which measures TSH testing around the time of diagnosis, also significantly missed its high ≥95% standard, achieving only 76.0%, a figure that has remained stubbornly flat over the last three years [^src1]. Long-term anticoagulation adherence (Indikator 4a1, 4a2, and 4a3) and annual kidney function monitoring for patients on DOACs (Indikator 4b) also fell short of their ≥90% and ≥95% thresholds, scoring between 87.3% and 93.9% [^src1]. While Indikator 7 (severe bleeding incidence) does not have a predefined standard, its incidence remained stable at 2.1 [^src1].

Entities: atrieflimren, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner faktisk opfyldelse af de 11 indikatorer i 2023/24 med tidligere år, og viser at kun Indikator 1, 2, 4b, 5 og 6 opfylder deres standarder, mens Indikator 3, 4a1–4a3 og 8 ligger under deres respektive standarder.
